pick.headline: United States invades Panama to oust Noriega
pick.summary: On 20 December 1989 US forces invaded Panama to remove General Manuel Noriega, the country's ruler and a former intelligence chief who had for years been a paid CIA asset.
pick.significance: Operation Just Cause, the largest US combat operation since Vietnam, ended in Noriega's surrender and trial in Miami on drug charges.

alternates.headline: Shevardnadze resigns, warning of coming dictatorship
alternates.summary: On 20 December 1990 Soviet Foreign Minister Eduard Shevardnadze resigned in a speech to the Congress of People's Deputies, warning that dictatorship was approaching.
alternates.significance: Shevardnadze had been Washington's partner in ending the Cold War. His warning proved prescient: hard-liners attempted a coup eight months later.
